mentions.name: tailpipe
mentions.description: A Rust crate installable via `cargo install` that provides a locally-hostable SSH server which plays back asciinema terminal recordings to connecting SSH clients. Runs on macOS and Linux (Windows untested), and requires clients to authenticate with a valid RSA or ED25519 key.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I pushed my first crate this weekend. You can `cargo install tailpipe` on macOS and Linux (and maybe Windows, haven’t tested there yet) and get a locally-hostable SSH server that plays back asciinema recordings to clients.

`ssh -p4242 tailpipe.clee.sh` for a quick demo without installing anything. Requires any valid RSA or ED25519 key.
